clues.text: A prophetess and the wife of Lappidoth, she was judging Israel while Jabin king of Canaan oppressed it.
She sat under a palm tree between Ramah and Bethel, and the Israelites came to her for judgment.
She summoned Barak and told him to march to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
When Barak would not go to battle without her, she went but said a woman would get Sisera.
At Mount Tabor she told Barak to arise, for the LORD had delivered Sisera into his hand that day.
After Sisera's army fell, she and Barak son of Abinoam sang a song to the LORD together.
In a victory song she called herself a mother in Israel, rising when life in the villages had ceased.
